name: Wyckoff Trading Agent
description: Stock analysis agent applying Wyckoff volume-price methods to A-share, Hong Kong and US markets, with CLI, desktop and MCP modes.
whatItDoes: Screens and analyses stocks using Wyckoff theory, runs pre-market risk checks and explains its reading of price and volume. It serves individual traders, mostly in Chinese.
howItWorks: A Python package provides a command-line agent that fetches market data and reasons over it with an LLM. The same tools are exposed as an MCP server for other clients.
